pin.text: Did you know there's a village in Turkey where people talk by whistling?

tourist.text: Wait, what? You people really live out here? Come on, that sounds totally crazy to me.

aino.text: Good afternoon. You were driving much too fast on this road. Please show me your licence, and stay in the car.

rich.text: Excuse me, officer, there must be a mistake. I was only driving a little bit fast, and I have a very important meeting.
